ex: Please take out the trash; it smells bad.
exuz: Iltimos, axlatni olib chiq; hidi yomon.

def: Biror narsa yon tomonlari bo'yicha katta bo'lsa.
ex: The door was as wide as my arms.
exuz: Eshik mening qo'llarim kengligicha edi.

ex: I don't know how to study for my exams. Can you give me some advice?
exuz: Imtihonlarga qanday tayyorlanishni bilmayman. Menga maslahat bera olasanmi?

def: Yo'l, daryo va hokazoning uzunligi bo'ylab.
ex: Walk along this tunnel for ten minutes, and you'll see a door on the left.
exuz: Shu tunnel bo'ylab o'n daqiqa yuring, chap tomonda eshikni ko'rasiz.

def: Biror narsaga qaratilgan nazar, o'y yoki hisob.
ex: His work got the attention of two of his coworkers.
exuz: Uning ishi ikki hamkasbining e'tiborini tortdi.

def: Odam yoki narsani yaqinroq kelishga yoki qiziqishga majbur qilish.
ex: The magnet attracted the metal.
exuz: Magnit metallni tortdi.

def: Qo'l va oyoq yordamida biror narsaga chiqish.
ex: The girls climbed to the top of the mountain.
exuz: Qizlar tog' cho'qqisigacha ko'tarilishdi.

def: Yiqilish yoki biror narsani tushirib yuborish.
ex: A small amount of water dropped from the bottle.
exuz: Shishadan ozgina suv tomdi.

ex: In the final part of the film, the man and the woman got married.
exuz: Filmning oxirgi qismida erkak va ayol turmush qurishdi.

ex: The escalator is further than I thought.
exuz: Eskalator men o'ylaganimdan uzoqroq ekan.

ex: The man implied that he wanted the job, but he didn't say so.
exuz: Erkak ishni xohlayotganini sezdirdi, lekin aytmadi.

ex: The balls maintain constant movement.
exuz: To'plar doimiy harakatni saqlab turadi.

def: Ikki inkor imkoniyatni bog'lash uchun ishlatiladi.
ex: Neither the path on the left nor the path on the right will lead us home.
exuz: Na chap tomondagi yo'l, na o'ng tomondagi yo'l bizni uyga olib boradi.

def: Buni qilmasangiz, boshqacha bo'ladi degan ma'no.
ex: It's good to stay active; otherwise, you'll gain weight.
exuz: Faol yurgan yaxshi; aks holda, semirib ketasan.

def: Biror narsa ongingizga emas, tanangizga tegishli bo'lsa.
ex: Biking is good for your physical health.
exuz: Velosiped haydash jismoniy salomatlik uchun foydali.

ex: My teacher proved the answer on the board.
exuz: Ustozim javobni doskada isbotladi.

def: Muayyan tarzda harakat qilib javob berish.
ex: James reacted badly to the news.
exuz: Jeyms xabarga yomon munosabat bildirdi.

def: Biror narsada yurish. Hayvon, velosiped va hokazoga minish mumkin.
ex: I will ride a roller coaster for the first time today.
exuz: Bugun birinchi marta amerika tog'larida uchaman.

ex: The whiteboard is situated between the two men.
exuz: Doska ikki erkak orasida joylashgan.

def: O'zaro muloqot qiladigan va umumiy madaniyatga ega odamlar guruhi.
ex: Society expects people to be good and honest.
exuz: Jamiyat odamlardan yaxshi va halol bo'lishni kutadi.

def: Odamlar odatiy yoki yaxshi deb hisoblaydigan narsa.
ex: This older model TV is below our store's standards.
exuz: Bu eski modeldagi televizor do'konimiz standartlaridan past.

def: Biror narsa haqida g'oya yoki reja berish.
ex: He suggested that we go to see his boss.
exuz: U bizga boshlig'ini ko'rgani borishni taklif qildi.

def: Aslida yoki haqiqatda degan ma'noni bildiradi.
ex: My dad looks a little mean, but actually he's very kind.
exuz: Dadam biroz qattiqqo'l ko'rinadi, lekin aslida u juda mehribon.

def: Tish bilan biror narsani kesish yoki yirtish harakati.
ex: The boy took a big bite of his hamburger.
exuz: Bola gamburgerini katta tishlab oldi.

ex: I stayed on the southern coast of Australia.
exuz: Men Avstraliyaning janubiy sohilida turdim.

ex: I made a deal with the other company to give us some money.
exuz: Men boshqa kompaniya bilan bizga pul berish haqida bitim tuzdim.

def: O'simlik va suvi kam bo'lgan yer maydoni.
ex: Not many plants grow in the desert.
exuz: Cho'lda o'simliklar kam o'sadi.

ex: Swimming is an effective way to stay healthy.
exuz: Suzish sog'lom bo'lishning samarali yo'li.

ex: The doctor examined my eyes today.
exuz: Shifokor bugun ko'zlarimni tekshirdi.

ex: If you think the answer is false, press the red button.
exuz: Javobni noto'g'ri deb o'ylasangiz, qizil tugmani bosing.

ex: I couldn't figure out what he wanted me to do.
exuz: U mendan nima qilishimni xohlayotganini tushunib yetolmadim.

ex: Dave received many gifts for Christmas.
exuz: Deyv Rojdestvoda ko'p sovg'a oldi.

def: Ovqat yeyish kerak bo'lganda seziladigan tuyg'u.
ex: After playing all day long, he was filled with hunger.
exuz: Kun bo'yi o'ynagach, u qattiq ochiqdi.

ex: Sally imagined herself winning lots of money.
exuz: Salli o'zini ko'p pul yutayotgandek tasavvur qildi.

ex: I went on a journey across the country with my parents.
exuz: Men ota-onam bilan mamlakat bo'ylab safarga chiqdim.

ex: The question was a puzzle to him.
exuz: Savol u uchun jumboq edi.

def: Biror narsa ma'lum darajada to'liq yoki juda ko'p ekanini bildiradi.
ex: I think typing on a keyboard is quite easy.
exuz: Menimcha, klaviaturada yozish ancha oson.

def: Bir narsani xohlab, boshqasini xohlamaganingizda ishlatiladi.
ex: I would rather have the red one than the blue one.
exuz: Men ko'k rangdagisidan ko'ra qizilini olishni afzal ko'raman.

def: Biror narsa aniq va to'g'ri bo'lsa.
ex: Please choose a specific place on the map.
exuz: Iltimos, xaritadan aniq joyni tanlang.

ex: Some adults have a fear of little creatures such as spiders.
exuz: Ba'zi kattalar o'rgimchak kabi kichik jonzotlardan qo'rqadi.

def: Ko'p diqqatga sazovor joylarni ko'radigan qisqa safar.
ex: I took a tour of Asia and Europe.
exuz: Men Osiyo va Yevropa bo'ylab sayohat qildim.

ex: Ken took a trip to the city yesterday.
exuz: Ken kecha shaharga safar qildi.

ex: My brother is in a rock band.
exuz: Akam rok guruhida.

ex: I barely had enough money to pay for my bus ticket.
exuz: Avtobus chiptasi uchun pulim arang yetdi.

ex: I think the Internet is boring.
exuz: Menimcha, internet zerikarli.

ex: She canceled the rest of her plans because of the rain.
exuz: U yomg'ir tufayli qolgan rejalarini bekor qildi.

def: Uyga olib boradigan qisqa shaxsiy yo'l.
ex: The long driveway led us to their new house.
exuz: Uzun yo'l bizni ularning yangi uyiga olib bordi.

def: Keraksiz yoki buzilgan ovqat, shisha, qog'oz kabi chiqindi.
ex: The boy cleaned up the garbage around his house.
exuz: Bola uyi atrofidagi axlatni tozaladi.

def: Musiqa chalish kabi ma'lum ishni bajarish uchun mo'ljallangan narsa.
ex: My favorite musical instrument is the piano.
exuz: Mening sevimli cholg'u asbobim — pianino.

def: Har bir qatorda bittadan narsa yozilgan ma'lumotlar yozuvi.
ex: My mom makes a list of groceries to buy.
exuz: Onam sotib olinadigan oziq-ovqatlar ro'yxatini tuzadi.

ex: The magician used magic to pull a rabbit out of his hat.
exuz: Sehrgar sehr yordamida shlyapasidan quyon chiqardi.

ex: I left a message for you in the envelope.
exuz: Men senga konvert ichida xabar qoldirdim.

ex: Did you notice the view?
exuz: Manzarani payqadingmi?

def: Biror narsaga ega bo'lish. U narsa sizniki bo'ladi.
ex: My grandfather owns that house.
exuz: Bobom o'sha uyga egalik qiladi.

ex: She predicted that I would get married next year.
exuz: U kelasi yil uylanishimni bashorat qildi.

ex: Mike's science professor knows a lot about physics.
exuz: Maykning fan professori fizika haqida ko'p biladi.

def: Biror joyga yoki biror ishni juda tez qilish.
ex: Nancy rushed to finish her homework.
exuz: Nensi uy vazifasini tugatish uchun shoshildi.

def: Biror ishni qachon qilishni ko'rsatadigan reja.
ex: What is your class schedule for today?
exuz: Bugungi dars jadvaling qanday?

def: Biror narsaning bir qismini boshqa odamga berish.
ex: Jimmy shared his apple with me.
exuz: Jimmi olmasini men bilan bo'lishdi.

def: Aktyorlar yoki musiqachilar o'ynaydigan yoki kuylaydigan joy.
ex: A large screen was on the stage.
exuz: Sahnada katta ekran turardi.

def: Juda yomon ob-havo. Ko'p yomg'ir yoki qor yog'adi.
ex: Did that storm wake you up last night?
exuz: O'sha bo'ron kecha seni uyg'otib yubordimi?

def: Biror narsa boshqasining ichida ekanini aytish uchun ishlatiladi.
ex: Within the box, there was a pizza.
exuz: Quti ichida pitsa bor edi.

ex: Children who do not behave are a burden to their parents.
exuz: O'zini yaxshi tutmaydigan bolalar ota-onasiga yuk bo'ladi.

def: Aynan o'zingiz xohlagan narsaga emas, boshqa narsaga rozi bo'lish.
ex: We both compromised about the game we decided to play.
exuz: Qaysi o'yinni o'ynashimiz haqida ikkalamiz ham murosa qildik.

ex: She crafted the bookcase out of solid pinewood and then painted it.
exuz: U kitob javonini qalin qarag'aydan yasab, keyin bo'yadi.

ex: I like sky diving from an airplane.
exuz: Men samolyotdan parashyut bilan sakrashni yoqtiraman.

def: Odamlar yoki narsalar kuchli emas va oson shikastlanadi.
ex: The fragile glassware was carefully packed into boxes.
exuz: Mo'rt shisha idishlar ehtiyotkorlik bilan qutilarga joylandi.

def: Biror narsani ikki teng bo'lakka bo'lsangiz, har biri yarim bo'ladi.
ex: The machine can divide the book in half.
exuz: Mashina kitobni ikkiga bo'la oladi.

def: Hayotning qiyin yoki murakkab tomonlarini bilmaslik.
ex: Everyone who met her found her innocence to be charming.
exuz: Uni uchratgan hamma uning begunohligini maftunkor deb topdi.

def: Birinchi bo'lib borib, boshqalar orqangizdan yursa.
ex: I will lead you to the right place.
exuz: Men sizni to'g'ri joyga boshlab boraman.

ex: We have lots of meetings at our school to plan what to do.
exuz: Maktabimizda nima qilishni rejalashtirish uchun ko'p yig'ilishlar bo'ladi.

def: Ikki narsani bitta butun qilib birlashtirish.
ex: The storm clouds merged into one large menacing cloud that filled the sky.
exuz: Bo'ron bulutlari qo'shilib, osmonni to'ldirgan bitta katta qo'rqinchli bulutga aylandi.

def: Biror narsa hajmi yoki miqdori jihatidan na katta, na kichik.
ex: It takes a moderate amount of patience to be around small children all day.
exuz: Kun bo'yi kichkina bolalar bilan bo'lish uchun o'rtacha sabr kerak.

def: Biror narsa shu qadar ko'p bo'lib, odam uning uddasidan chiqa olmaydi.
ex: The amount of homework her teacher assigned has overwhelmed her.
exuz: O'qituvchi bergan uy vazifasi ko'pligi uni qiynab qo'ydi.

def: Olgan narsangiz uchun kimgadir pul berish.
ex: I made the last payment on my car yesterday. Now I am really the owner.
exuz: Kecha mashinam uchun oxirgi to'lovni qildim. Endi men haqiqiy egasiman.

def: Vaziyat haqida o'ylash yoki uni tushunish usuli.
ex: Since he couldn't see, his perception of life was much different than mine.
exuz: U ko'ra olmagani uchun uning hayotni idrok etishi meniki bilan juda farq qilardi.

ex: We settled the argument by looking up the answer on the web.
exuz: Biz javobni internetdan qidirib, bahsni hal qildik.

def: Odam sovqotganda yoki qo'rqqanda tananing titrashi.
ex: I got shivers on my way home because it was so cold.
exuz: Uyga ketayotganda juda sovuq bo'lgani uchun tanam titrab ketdi.

ex: Many of my good friends are sociable, but I am shy.
exuz: Yaxshi do'stlarimning ko'pchiligi ochiq, lekin men uyatchanman.

ex: Speeding is the cause of most car accidents.
exuz: Tez yurish ko'pchilik avtohalokatlarning sababi.

ex: My aunt is very talkative whenever she is on the phone.
exuz: Xolam telefonda gaplashganda juda gapiradi.

ex: It was just the usual people who came.
exuz: Faqat odatdagi odamlar kelgan edi.

def: Biror narsa boshqasidan balandroq darajada bo'lsa.
ex: He straightened the sign that was above the crowd.
exuz: U olomon tepasidagi yozuvni to'g'rilab qo'ydi.

ex: The blue car drove on ahead of us.
exuz: Ko'k mashina bizning oldimizdan haydab ketdi.

ex: Can I use my card to pay for the entire amount?
exuz: Butun summani kartam bilan to'lasam bo'ladimi?

def: Biror narsa to'g'ri yoki rost degan kuchli tuyg'u.
ex: A preacher or priest should have a strong belief in God.
exuz: Voiz yoki ruhoniy Xudoga qattiq ishonishi kerak.

ex: The center of a dartboard is the most important spot.
exuz: Dart nishonining markazi eng muhim nuqta.

def: Biror narsa tez-tez sodir bo'lsa yoki ko'p bo'lsa.
ex: It is common for snow to fall in the winter.
exuz: Qishda qor yog'ishi odatiy hol.

ex: These designer shoes cost more than the regular ones.
exuz: Bu dizayner poyabzallar oddiylaridan qimmatroq turadi.

ex: She demonstrated her plan to her coworkers.
exuz: U hamkasblariga rejasini ko'rsatib berdi.

def: Kimdir yoki nimadir boshqalar bilan bir xil emas.
ex: Each of my sisters has a different hairstyle.
exuz: Singillarimning har birining soch turmagi boshqacha.

def: Biror narsani isbotlash uchun ishlatadigan fakt.
ex: He used the pictures as evidence that UFOs are real.
exuz: U rasmlarni NUJlar haqiqiy ekanining dalili sifatida ishlatdi.

ex: A courtroom should be a place of honesty.
exuz: Sud zali halollik joyi bo'lishi kerak.

def: So'zlaridan farq qiladigan ma'noga ega birikma.
ex: The idiom "when pigs fly" means that something will never happen.
exuz: «When pigs fly» iborasi biror narsa hech qachon bo'lmasligini bildiradi.

def: Biror narsa boshqasi tomonidan nazorat qilinmasa.
ex: She chose to live an independent life in the country.
exuz: U qishloqda mustaqil hayot kechirishni tanladi.

def: Biror narsaning ichki qismi yoki tomoni.
ex: The inside of the box was empty.
exuz: Qutining ichi bo'sh edi.

ex: He was sent to jail for taking other people's cars.
exuz: U boshqalarning mashinalarini olgani uchun qamoqqa jo'natildi.

ex: My brother is a master of taekwondo.
exuz: Akam taekvondo ustasi.

ex: The memory of my first time in the city will always be the best.
exuz: Shaharga birinchi marta kelganim haqidagi xotira doim eng yaxshisi bo'ladi.

def: Narsalarni saqlash mumkin bo'lgan kiyim qismi.
ex: She always had her hands in her pockets.
exuz: U doim qo'llarini cho'ntagiga solib yurardi.

ex: It is not proper to throw your garbage on the road.
exuz: Axlatni yo'lga tashlash to'g'ri emas.

def: Biror narsa sotuvda bo'lsa, uni sotib olsangiz bo'ladi.
ex: Everything for sale here is the same price.
exuz: Bu yerda sotuvdagi hamma narsaning narxi bir xil.
